sourceDetail: Cabin geometry (number, deck, geometric-centre x/y in the deck-SVG coordinate space, fill colour) parsed from deckmaps.com versioned deck SVGs (/data/out/msc/msc-seascape/vlatest/deck-<N>.<hash>.svg), one element with class "cabin-shape" and a data-cabin attribute per stateroom (1908 <rect> + 52 <polygon> = 1960 shapes across the 10 guest decks deckmaps publishes with cabins). Deck-SVG URLs/hashes were resolved live from the deckmaps app's own network requests, then each SVG fetched by direct GET (HTTP 200). Category legend built by matching each fill colour to an MSC stateroom category, verified per-colour against MSC's standardised deck-plan palette as recorded in the proven MSC World Europa and MSC Fantasia extractions, and cross-checked against MSC Seascape category names on cruisedeckplans.com.

notes.completeness: PARTIAL grid, and a TEMPLATE for one sister only. 1959 unique staterooms extracted from deckmaps' vlatest across the 10 guest decks it publishes with cabins (5,10,11,12,13,14,15,16,18,19). deckmaps advertises 1960 cabin shapes; the extra shape is a mislabeled duplicate (a stray 'cabin12125' rendered on the deck-15 SVG whose number belongs to deck 12) which was de-duped to the single correct deck-12 instance. deckmaps also serves EMPTY deck pages for decks 6 and 20 (0 cabins) and publishes NO deck plan at all for decks 7, 8, 9 and 17. MSC Seascape's real capacity is ~2270 staterooms, so roughly 310 cabins are NOT covered here - principally the lower main cabin decks (8/9) and any staterooms on the un-served decks; deckmaps does not publish those pages, so their exact cabin numbers/counts are unknown and were NOT invented. SCOPE: this grid is the layout template for MSC Seascape and, because Seascape is the stretched 'Seaside EVO' build, for its true sister MSC Seashore ONLY. It does NOT cover the shorter original Seaside-class ships MSC Seaside or MSC Seaview - those have different, shorter deck layouts, are not on these deckmaps, and are not represented by this file.
notes.category: deckmaps encodes category only via cabin fill colour. 11 distinct fills map to 8 categories (MSC uses a standardised palette; several fills share a category - e.g. #4ca66f/#00443d both Balcony, #cdc9ba/#b8b1a2 both MSC Yacht Club Deluxe Suite, #ef8227/#e95b0e both Grand Suite). deckmaps' colour granularity is coarser than MSC's full Yacht Club line-up: cruisedeckplans lists five Yacht Club tiers (Interior/Inside, Deluxe Suite, Grand Suite, Royal Suite, Owner Suite) but the SVGs distinguish only Interior (#d7d5d1), Deluxe Suite (#cdc9ba/#b8b1a2) and a 2-cabin premium tier mapped here to Royal Suite (#61564a); Yacht Club Grand/Owner suites are not separately coloured. See colorLegend.
notes.section: DERIVED heuristic. Long axis is x; bow direction confirmed per deck from cabin numbering (lowest number, e.g. the x001 bow-suite stack, sits at high x on every deck). section = forward/mid/aft thirds of each deck's x extent. Approximate.
notes.side: DERIVED heuristic. Beam is the y axis; cabins split at each deck's y midpoint, labelled port (lower y) / starboard (higher y) by the MSC-plan convention used in the sister extractions. Could be uniformly mirrored - validate against a known cabin before relying on port vs starboard.
notes.obstructed: deckmaps SVGs carry no obstructed-view flag; obstructed=false for all (source does not encode obstruction, not asserted as clear-view).
